title: status bar icons follow the app theme, not the system's

commit.merge_subject: merge: status bar icons follow the app theme, not the system's

description:
Owner report: light app theme but white status bar icons. MainActivity's
enableEdgeToEdge() default is SystemBarStyle.auto, which picks light or
dark icons from the SYSTEM night-mode flag; the app has its own
Light/System/Dark choice, so a dark phone with the app set to Light kept
white icons on a light surface, and an in-app theme change never re-ran
the detection.

SystemBarIconsEffect drives the window's isAppearanceLightStatusBars and
isAppearanceLightNavigationBars (WindowInsetsControllerCompat) from the
app's resolved theme after every composition. The editor and timeline
chrome are dark in both modes (RitimTheme(editor = true)), so those
routes keep light icons. Verified on device: dark clock/icons and a dark
gesture pill on the light Library.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
